title: Version 57 Released
body:
##  Version 57 Released 

In version V57, topics with new or revised pathways include: Developmental biology ([RET signaling](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-8853659.1>)), Disease ([Signaling by FGFR in disease](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-1226099.3>) and [Defective CFTR causes cystic fibrosis](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-5678895.2>)), Gene expression ([rRNA modification in the mitochondrion](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-6793080.1>) and [Transcriptional regulation by the AP-2 (TFAP2) family of transcription factors](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-8864260.1>)), Immune system ([ER-Phagosome pathway](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-1236974.2>), [Interleukin-7 signaling](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-1266695.3>), [Regulation by endogenous TLR ligand](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-5686938.1>), and [TCR signaling](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-202403.3>)), Metabolism ([Lipid digestion, mobilization, and transport](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-73923.3>) and [Phosphate bond hydrolysis by NTPDase proteins](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-8850843.1>)). Metabolism of proteins ([Deubiquitination](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-5688426.1>)), Neuronal system ([Interactions of neurexins and neuroligins at synapses](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-6794361>) and [SALM protein interactions at synapse](</PathwayBrowser/#/R-HSA-8849932>)). Signal transduction ([EGFR downregulation](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-182971.3>), [Signaling by FGFR1](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-5654736.3>), and [FGFRL1 modulation of FGFR1 signaling](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-5658623.2>)), Transmembrane transport of small molecules ([ABC-family proteins mediated transport](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-382556.2>)) and Vesicle-mediated transport ([Clathrin-mediated endocytosis](</PathwayBrowser/#R-HSA-8856828.1>)).
